classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. The ray ending at 1 is contained in the ray ending at 3; their intersection includes 1.

content.prompt:
Simplify the following sets and write the result as a single interval.
$$(-\infty,3]\cap(-\infty,1]$$

answer.worked:
The common points satisfy both $x\le3$ and $x\le1$, so they are exactly the points with $x\le1$.
$$(-\infty,3]\cap(-\infty,1]=(-\infty,1].$$
